decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-e43d2dd8091a] says the fix is to "Fix the logger when enabling send anonymous usage" and shows it reproduced with `--global.sendanonymoususage`. That gives the open applicability aspect: only environments with global.sendAnonymousUsage enabled are exposed. The changelog line [ev-1a93967aa9fb] and the example startup log in [ev-97f8220faf20] show the subject is the anonymous-usage log messages, not the usage data that gets sent. The PR changes only cmd/traefik/traefik.go [ev-41c57b376ddc], so the consequence is limited to the logs: the messages are no longer repeated cumulatively. This also corrects P1's reading that usage data was sent cumulatively.
